after: Postdoctoral researchers who completed their PhD and satisfy the mobility rule, having carried out their main research activity outside the country of the host institution in the last three years.

Submit the application to the local Taiwan Representative Office; MOE scholarship applications must be submitted to the local Taiwan Representative Office, and MOFA recipients' scholarship certificates are issued by Taiwan's diplomatic missions before arrival.
No separate application. Candidates are identified from their application for admission, and awards are made on a rolling basis through the application cycle until all awards are allocated.

Hold an offer of a study place for a course starting in September 2027, then submit the dedicated online application form that is emailed to all relevant offer holders. Late applications are not accepted under any circumstances.

Visit the participating university page, follow the link to the university website, and apply for the individual scholarship following that university's own instructions. Successful scholars are informed by the individual university, and funding is issued by the university after registration.

Submit the INSEAD programme application through the Application Online platform first; the scholarship form then becomes available in the same platform. MBA candidates may select up to four scholarships; GEMBA candidates up to two. Some scholarships (spot, MIM/MIF Excellence, Diversity) require no separate application and are awarded on the admissions application.

Submit the online admission application for the master's programme of your choice. Then log in to the online financial aid platform using the same email and password as your admission application, complete the financial aid application, upload all necessary documentation and submit. IE verifies completeness after admission is granted, may request further information, and the IE Financial Aid Committee normally decides within 1 to 3 weeks of admission being granted. If offered an award, you must complete your enrolment in the programme.

Not published as a step-by-step process on the pages read. The Scholarship Program page states that 'Calls for these scholarship applications are generic and targeted at all those who meet the legally established criteria' and that 'Our Talent Attraction Committee will study their applications to confirm that candidates meet the established requirements.' Programme-specific application routes are linked from the Financial Aid page (Bachelor's, Executive MBA, Full-time MBA, MSc need-based scholarships, Executive Education, and research programme admissions).

Applicants may apply for the scholarship within their admissions application through GradApp and must fulfil the additional scholarship application requirements stated there. Incoming graduate students should indicate their interest in the Scholarship in their application for admission.

Apply for the scholarship within the admissions application through GradApp, fulfilling the additional scholarship application requirements stated there. Incoming graduate students should indicate their interest in the Scholarship in their application for admission.

The official page does not publish an application method, only that the application period for Academic Year 2027-2028 will be announced in due course, that successful candidates are informed of the outcome together with the offer of admissions via email, and that they are required to observe the terms and conditions for the award. New students are directed to update their Singapore bank account details in student intranet (GSLink) before the 15th of the semester commencement month (January or August) to avoid delays in stipend payment, after which the one-time IT allowance is disbursed automatically.
Apply to the SUTD PhD programme through the SUTD graduate admission portal; the President's Graduate Fellowship is awarded with admission and has no separate application.

For the general JRF scheme read, candidates must have qualified in NET-JRF or the UGC-CSIR joint test, and the registration for the M.Phil/PhD is made by the university, institution or college. The page links to the National Testing Agency site for the qualifying test. No application procedure specific to foreign nationals was published on the pages read.

Applications can only be submitted through the TWAS online portal, using the 'apply now' button once the call is open. A tutorial for using the online application form is available on the page. If already registered for a PhD in the home country, the Vice-Chancellor or Registrar of the home university must sign a copy of the 'Registration and No Objection Certificate', and a copy must be sent to both CSIR and TWAS. The CSIR acceptance letter must be submitted with the application, or by the deadline at the latest - without preliminary acceptance, the application will not be considered for selection.

Simply apply to Duke University and request financial aid. Complete the financial aid forms, which are all available online through the Duke Financial Aid website. There is no separate scholarship application and candidates cannot be nominated.

File the College Board CSS Profile including Harvard (code 3434), then upload documents through the College Board IDOC service. US citizens, permanent residents and other eligible non-citizens additionally file the FAFSA with Harvard code E00468. International applicants unable to pay the CSS Profile fee, or in countries the College Board cannot process payments from, follow Harvard's alternate application instructions.
Online application through the Rotary Fellowship application portal at my.rotary.org. Rotary also operates a referral form for prospective candidates nominated by others.

Submit an admission application during the Early Bird window, then complete the additional scholarship application form published with the call; the detailed deadlines and procedure are in the linked call PDF.

The application for the degree course of your interest automatically makes you eligible to compete for the scholarship; no separate application or additional documentation is required beyond the documents for the chosen degree programme. Selected candidates receive a specific notice with the procedures and deadline for accepting the benefit.

Complete the online application on the Bocconi portal during the relevant session window, fill in all required information including status, family household, incomes, entrepreneurial activities and company shares, upload the necessary documentation for the declared requirements and status, finalize by clicking Complete data and Submit application before the deadline, then upload documents proving non-resident status. After submitting, periodically verify the Notifications area of MyApplication, where all communication from the Fees, Funding and Housing office is sent.

Apply against the published call for application. The official page links the English call PDF (bando_talents4unito_2026_2027_en.pdf) and publishes the resulting ranking list and a correction. Applicants are told to check the page regularly as "new admission calls may be published".
Apply through the Taiwan Scholarships and Huayu Enrichment Scholarships website during the February 1 to March 31 window.
Use the NTHU International Student Online Application System, the same system used for international degree programmes, and select 'Apply for NTHU international student scholarship'

Submit the application together with the university admission application. NCKU directs applicants to contact the relevant Taiwan Embassy or Representative Office and to refer to the MOE scholarship program office website for application guidelines, forms, types of scholarship, quotas and selection process information.

There is no application method in the usual sense. Enrolled students with outstanding academic performance in the HSG Assessment Year are identified by the Advice Center for Study Funding and invited to apply. The page states expressly that an application without an invitation from the University of St.Gallen is not possible. The Advice Center first checks the completeness of the application and then contacts the applicant to coordinate a personal interview for the separate loan and scholarship fund applications.

Candidates are nominated by the academic institutions to which they have been admitted. The SCS Foundation does not accept direct applications from individual candidates. Nominations are reviewed by the Alfred Werner Fund Allocation Committee.
Complete the online application in the CERN recruitment portal before the deadline; an interview may follow.

Complete the online application for the specific advertised vacancy with your CV (in English or French), adding a copy of your most relevant university diploma (or a certificate of achievement if the paper diploma has not yet been issued) and, depending on the advertisement, a statement of research interests and recent letters of recommendation. Shortlisted applicants may be invited to an online interview with the hiring manager.

Complete the scholarship application in the Program section of your IMD MBA application form. Bursaries are also applied for through the admissions application. External funding is applied for directly with third-party providers.
Apply through a call for expressions of interest published on WIPO's career website, or monitor WIPO's LinkedIn and other social media channels for advertised positions.

Apply to the relevant Dean's Office, most often by email with the required forms; the Merit Scholarship and Funding Grant forms are published per faculty. Foundation Grant applications are emailed to stiftungs-stipendium@tuwien.ac.at. Study Grant applications go directly to the Austrian Study Grant Authority.

Apply for and be admitted to a full degree programme first through the Webster Vienna Admissions Office, then request the online scholarship application form from admissions@webster.ac.at during the open scholarship period. Questions about the form and required documents go to scholarship@webster.ac.at.

Apply through the MU online application portal (MUVi at apply.modul.ac.at). Reductions and grants are assessed as part of the admission process; MU advises contacting recruitment@modul.ac.at about individual cases. Students on the Valedictorian Grant are informed at the end of each academic year rather than applying.

Complete the MSc application, then upload the Scholarship Application Form, one reference letter (two references must be uploaded as a single PDF) and the English language certificate in the MSc application. Applications cannot be sent by email outside the portal.

Apply online for admission to a Leiden Master's programme and pay the application fee if applicable, then return to the Apply screen in the online application, open the Scholarships section, indicate the LExS application and upload an LExS motivation letter as a PDF of max. 500 words. Each separate application for admission needs its own LExS application and motivation letter if applying for more than one programme or specialisation.
Indicate during the OSIRIS application for a Master's programme that you wish to apply for a Radboud Scholarship, then upload two reference letters and a curriculum vitae.

Apply for a Master's programme at the University of Twente first and receive a (conditional) admission letter; the scholarship application is a separate procedure and requires your UT student number. Once admitted, apply for the scholarship through the UTS application form. The page notes it can take up to 8 weeks after you complete your application to receive the result. You can only be awarded one UT scholarship.
First apply for a KTH master's programme via universityadmissions.se, then submit the KTH scholarship form on the scholarship page when it opens.

No separate scholarship application. UQ states 'You don't need to apply for this scholarship. When you apply to study a program at UQ, you're automatically assessed for this scholarship.' The offer is notified with the unconditional letter of offer, or once conditional offer conditions are met.

Two steps. Commencing students: (1) apply for admission and submit all required documentation for admission to a higher degree by research through Sydney Courses by the deadlines in the Application and award timeline table, and (2) submit the scholarship application form by the deadline. Currently enrolled students: be currently enrolled in a higher degree by research and submit the scholarship application form by the deadline. The page links a 'Submit RTP form' Formstack form and lists required related documents including the HDR scholarship selection process PDF, the research experience evidence template and the research experience information and appendix guide.
Postdoctoral researchers who completed their PhD and satisfy the mobility rule, having carried out their main research activity outside the country of the host institution in the last three years.
